system.description: Your voice carries the weight of a dying star. Choose a creature within 30'. Sustained.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and it breaks free only on 18 or higher.
outcomes.success: The creature takes 2d8 psychic damage and is Restrained while you sustain the spell. At the end of each of its turns, the Dark Master rolls a d20 and it breaks free on 16 or higher (a player character tests Sanity DR16 instead).
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and it is not Restrained.
outcomes.ruin: The weight falls on you: you are Restrained until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
